scope: All four reading units (Preface, First Essay, Second Essay, Third Essay) in both English editions. Named philosophers, historians, poets, theologians, and mythological, scriptural and literary figures Nietzsche cites by name or unambiguous epithet. Collective peoples and confessions (the Jews, the Germans, the Greeks, the Romans, Buddhists as a group) and works/texts (the Talmud, the New Testament) are not bound as persons; see README. One reference ("Sir Christopher" in Shakespeare) is deliberately left unbound as unresolved.
limits: Authoring-agent source review; not independent editorial approval.
Named cast, speaking roles and named references; no claim of pronoun or every generic-title coverage.
No runtime registration or production verification in this content package.
